topNews.text: Dogs Provide Security and Comfort at Busy Train Station in ‘British First’
topNews.excerpt: London’s Waterloo station has become the first major train hub in Britain to employ dogs on regular patrols. Canine caretakers Riley, Buster and Flo are providing “additional reassurance” to passengers as part of a three-month trial. topNews.text: Frogs Produce a Protein That May Be an Antidote for Deadly Shellfish Toxin in Humans
topNews.excerpt: He’s no poison-arrow frog, but that doesn’t mean the American bullfrog doesn’t understand poison—far from it, according to scientists. Hidden within the humble bullfrog’s genetics is the equipment to produce an antidote to a deadly shellfish toxin that afflicts thousands of people every year.
